currentTimetableUncertainty: Official landing page exposes May 2026 SWTT 78. Aug/Sep 2026 secondary reports link to an official X update about SWTT 79 effective 01-Sep-2026. The full newer official timetable was not located, so do not claim these schedules are current.
unknowns: Charged fare distance, station-pair routing restrictions, fare rounding and current fare table are not established by the system map.
No additional WR suburban branch beyond the shared Harbour segment has been verified; do not infer the Borivali Harbour extension is operational.
Dadar DDR is distinct from CR Dadar DR. Interchange is a pedestrian/transfer edge, not a rail segment with zero fare km.
Cross-line journeys require explicit route selection; do not replace railway distance with straight-line or road distance.
May 2026 AC snapshot does not establish live operations, cancellations, September 2026 revisions, or an AC service for every station pair. Query individual stop lists in travel direction.
AC source column symbols on trains 94117, 94006 and 94024 were preserved as unresolved notes. Day-specific use requires checking the original timetable footnotes.

acValidation.limitation: Source snapshot effective 2026-05-01; later September timetable not directly verified. The 26 columns marked SAT & SUN NON AC are restricted to weekdays for AC. Other days remain unspecified, not asserted daily. Three source symbol annotations remain unresolved.
